notes: Card: ',' x15, mostly 'publish, distribute' in MIT licence text, plus URL domain pieces (.edu, .mil) and '#'. Probe: MIT grant list 0.79; URLs only 0.11-0.13; shopping-list commas 0.03; licence prose without the verb list 0.07. Near misses include ordinary verb lists to test whether it is the licence list or any verb list.
